Paranormal creators Sam and Colby join the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 1922. The pair built a huge online following by spending nights in haunted houses and filming what happens. Rogan, a skeptic with a soft spot for ghost stories, gives them the floor.

They trade their best ghost-hunting stories, from famous haunted sites to nights that scared them off a location. Rogan asks how they rule out tricks and what they truly believe they caught. The episode is a storyteller's session: part travel log of America's spookiest places, part debate over whether anything out there answers back.

German author Norman Ohler brings his book Blitzed to episode 2183 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Ohler researched how deeply Nazi Germany ran on drugs, from soldiers' meth to Hitler's own injections. His work changed how many readers picture the Third Reich.

Ohler explains how the stimulant Pervitin fueled the early blitzkrieg campaigns. He describes the drug culture around Hitler and his personal doctor's cocktail of shots. Rogan asks how much the highs and crashes shaped decisions that killed millions. History's dark students get a gripping, well-sourced tour of the Wehrmacht's hidden fuel.
